### Added

- (agent-platform) [Offer an organization's own connectors in the agent Tools step](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3615) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — When you create or edit an agent of an organization, the Tools step has a section `Connectors from the organization page` that offers the organization's connectors, says whether each is ready, and gives the agent the ones you pick. Needs agent-manager 3.3 or later.
- (agent-platform) [Rework the Customize › Models list: columns, filters, Default badge, Model hosting row](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3625) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Customize › Models lists every model in one table with its owner, provider, environment, status and the agents using it, marks default models with `Default`, filters by owner, provider, status and use, and links to Model hosting from a row above the search. `Connect a model` is now `Add a model`.
- (gs) [Add the Platform cluster page's Node pools tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3613) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Where the Platform section is turned on (`gs.features.platformSection.enabled`), a cluster's page has a Node pools tab listing its node pools, with the nodes and technical details of the one you select. On the classic cluster page, the Nodes tab gives memory as `9.1 GiB` instead of `9.1 Gi`.
- (muster) [Give an organization's connector a page address of its own](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3616) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Every connector an organization owns has its own page, also when another organization has one of the same name, and opens from the Connectors page and the search. Old links still lead to it, or to a list of the connectors of that name.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Organization check errors once with a working action, connector texts that promise what exists](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3623) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — The Organizations page lists an installation it could not check once, under the collapsed line, and offers `Sign out of the portal` and `Check again` where the Agent Manager connector lost its sign-in. An organization's Tools step says how a connector is added, and that `Nothing outside the chat` also turns off its connectors.

### Development and CI/CD

- (several plugins) [Upgrade to Backstage 1.57](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3624) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.44.2...v3.45.0
